answer: Earning is gated at one public mesh vertex: the occupant locks 0.81 POA for six epochs and files a sealed work core. Every eight hours the beacon's trailing 48 bits light an ember draw that cracks 1 in 19 cores. Each cracked core must show three task receipts started 65 minutes apart, keyed to that vertex id plus the custody hash, so a pasted log fails. Auditors replay the ember index on the live tip; a failed draw costs 0.037 POA. Shared core prefixes, or five wallets funded in 100 minutes from one root (a shale stack), cut every cluster bond 50 percent and darken the mailbox for 3 epochs.
